description: Multichain transaction lookup: Transaction and receipt by hash on base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, bsc, base-sepolia: from, to, value, status, gas used, fee, confirmations, contract created, and every ERC-20 Transfer it emitted (up to 50). Source: publicnode JSON-RPC. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: transaction{...}, receipt{status, gas_used, fee_native}, erc20_transfers[].

network.description: one of base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche, bsc, base-sepolia (default base)

name: x420_chain_tx
